name: @dcp/thefirestore-failure-case
description: DELIBERATE FAILURE CASE: nine Button modifiers modeled as nine separate components. This is the shape of output when an extraction pipeline observes .button--primary, .button--secondary, .button--tertiary, .button--accent, .button--large, .button--small, .button--slab, .button--icon, and .button--inputAction as sibling selectors and has no principled way to decide which are color-axis variants, which are size-axis variants, which are state modifiers, and which are distinct components entirely.
